title: orthosia glaberrima
intro: Orthosia glaberrima, commonly known as the Smooth Orthosia, is a plant species that belongs to the family Gentianaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to provide several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may aid in reducing the risk of chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of Orthosia glaberrima include its ability to exhibit antimicrobial properties, which help protect against infections, and its anti-cancer properties, which may inhibit the growth of cancer cells. The bioactive constituents of Orthosia glaberrima include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
